brief:
Drop Site News reported that former President Donald Trump has threatened measures with global economic implications, while Iran pledged a broad response to recent Israeli military operations. The developments mark an escalation in regional tensions amid ongoing hostilities in the Middle East.

Israel killed 29 Palestinians in the latest phase of military operations, according to the war brief summary. The casualties occurred as the conflict persisted across multiple fronts with diplomatic and military pressures intensifying.
title: Trump threatens tariffs as Iran vows response to Israeli strikes
